title: Kuih Seri Muka
description: Kuih Seri Muka is a dish from Malaysia prepared with glutinous rice, coconut milk, chicken egg, pandan leaves. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the measured rice or noodles in clean cool water for about 220 minutes, then drain and proceed to the specified cooking step.
Steam the prepared ingredients in a covered steamer for about 25 minutes, until fully set or cooked; use food-safe leaves and ensure any protein reaches a safe temperature.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Pour the strained pandan-coconut egg custard over the already steamed sticky-rice layer and steam gently until fully set.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 90 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
